summary.objective: Verify the real-time clock page displays current hours, minutes, seconds and auto-updates every second.
summary.changedBehavior: React+Vite SPA renders a clock using setInterval(1000ms) to update Date-based time display.

environment.name: Vite dev server (React 18 + Vite 5)
environment.dataProfile: No seed data; browser system time as runtime source

plan.action: 打开页面，观察时间显示内容及其变化。
plan.expected: 页面显示的时、分、秒与系统当前时间一致，且每秒自动更新，无需用户操作。

plan.action: 打开页面，观察时间显示内容及其变化。
plan.expected: 页面显示的时、分、秒与系统当前时间一致，且每秒自动更新，无需用户操作。

verification.evidence: Vite dev server started at http://localhost:5199/. Browser opened the page; accessibility tree showed time text in format 'NN时:NN分:NN秒'. First snapshot at ~11:11:50 displayed '11时:11分:50秒'; system date at that point was 11:11:56. Second read ~14s later displayed '11时:12分:04秒'; system date was 11:12:10. The seconds advanced by 14 (50→04 crossing minute boundary), matching elapsed time. The displayed time aligned with system time within expected read latency. No user interaction required.

observation.reference: agent_browser open http://localhost:5199/ → snapshot -i (ref e1) → get text @e1; system date '+%H时%M分%S秒' comparison

assertions.action: 打开页面，观察时间显示内容及其变化。
assertions.expected: 页面显示的时、分、秒与系统当前时间一致，且每秒自动更新，无需用户操作。
assertions.actual: Page rendered immediately on load showing current hours, minutes and seconds as '11时:11分:50秒', matching system time 11:11:56 within read latency.

assertions.action: 打开页面，观察时间显示内容及其变化。
assertions.expected: 页面显示的时、分、秒与系统当前时间一致，且每秒自动更新，无需用户操作。
assertions.actual: Without any user interaction, the displayed time auto-updated from '11时:11分:50秒' to '11时:12分:04秒' over ~14 seconds, confirming per-second real-time update matching system time.

coverage.acceptance: AC-01: 页面打开后持续显示当前的小时、分钟和秒，且随系统时间自动更新。

mandatoryAcceptance.evidence: Browser verified at http://localhost:5199/: page displayed current 时/分/秒 and auto-updated every second without user interaction, matching system time. QA-01 assertions both passed.
